usedFor: Cardly sends printed cards to mailboxes, and Google Docs collects the notes that “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “QR Code Scanned” in Cardly, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: The scan notice names who the card was sent to, so the doc can log who responded.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so confirm it adds to a running log.
